fertilizer: Neem Coated Urea (100kg/acre), DAP (50kg/acre), MOP (40kg/acre), Panchagavya 3%
soil: Clay loam, alluvial soil with pH 5.5 - 6.5
pest: Yellow Stem Borer, Brown Plant Hopper (BPH), Rice Leaf Folder
disease: Paddy Leaf Blast, Sheath Blight, Bacterial Leaf Streak
harvest: 110 - 130 days after sowing (when 80% grains turn golden yellow)
